transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: S-Net TV digital services, my name is Gary.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Gary, my name is Philip Vance. I pay thirty pounds a month for your S-Net Sports HD package, but our TV set-top box is blocking all four sports channels with an on-screen error CS-201 saying 'Subscription Required - Contact Customer Care', even though the package is active on my online account!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Philip. If I understand correctly, your TV set-top box is blocking all your sports channels with error CS-201 stating a subscription is required, despite your package being fully active. Before we query your card entitlements, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 19 Crescent Road, Sheffield, S7 1HN, security PIN 4419, smartcard ID SN-TV-881902.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Philip, that confirms your account details. Have you tried power-cycling the TV set-top box from the wall socket for thirty seconds?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I rebooted the box three times this morning and rescanned for channels; every other channel works, but the sports channels display error CS-201!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query your subscription entitlement pairing on the conditional access gateway?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Philip. The conditional access gateway indicates that your sports package digital tier encryption key has expired.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why would our encryption key expire when our monthly direct debit is paid up to date?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Subscription tier encryption keys refresh automatically via satellite and fiber carousels once every thirty calendar days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you send an over-the-air entitlement refresh command to reactivate the keys right now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you leave your TV set-top box powered down at the wall plug overnight to save electricity, the box misses the automated overnight security refresh cycles.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I turn off wall sockets at night to reduce our carbon footprint! Why are you blaming me for your software missing its refresh?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am stating the operational reality of encrypted broadcast conditional access systems.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will you transmit the manual entitlement refresh signal or not?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Manual entitlement refresh commands can be dispatched across our broadband return path.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Gary? Are you still on the phone? The line went completely silent for over thirty seconds!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was authenticating the broadcast security certificate on the central multiplexer.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please send the activation command immediately.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously encrypted broadcast video channels require valid cryptoperiod authorization blocks to decode high-definition streams.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I know encryption requires authorization; I am asking you to transmit the keys!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Philip speaking, I have twenty friends arriving at my house in two hours for the North London derby match! I bought six hundred pounds worth of food and drinks for this gathering, and my sixty-five-inch screen is showing error CS-201! If my guests arrive and cannot watch the match after paying thirty pounds a month, I will look like an absolute fool and my weekend will be destroyed! I am furious and panicking!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the intense panic and fury this is causing with twenty guests arriving for the derby match in two hours, Philip. Preparing a major gathering with friends only to see error CS-201 on the screen is extremely stressful, and I will force an immediate entitlement re-hit to restore your sports channels right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Gary. How long does the re-hit take to clear error CS-201?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am dispatching an emergency Tier-1 over-the-air entitlement signal directly to your smartcard ID SN-TV-881902.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The TV screen just flashed black for two seconds and returned to error CS-201.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The conditional access subsystem takes between sixty and one hundred and twenty minutes to cycle through the cryptographic key rings.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sixty to one hundred and twenty minutes?! My guests arrive in one hundred and twenty minutes!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Cryptographic key cycles are governed by broadcast carousel frequency schedules.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So we cannot verify right now while we are on this call whether the sports channels will actually turn on?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. The entitlement re-hit has been sent, but the channels will remain locked until the key ring cycle completes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can I watch the match on the S-Net TV mobile app on my tablet as a temporary backup?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, your online account credentials allow immediate live streaming on the S-Net TV mobile application.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me check the mobile app on my phone... S-Net Sports 1 is streaming live on my phone right now!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Gary? Hello? Did the phone cut out again? Why does your line keep dropping into complete dead air?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I was documenting your mobile streaming workaround under case reference TV-SPORT-88192-V.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: TV-SPORT-88192-V, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can cast the mobile stream from your tablet directly to your television via AirPlay or Chromecast if the box key cycle takes longer than expected.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That provides a viable emergency backup if the TV box is still updating at kick-off.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also set an automated re-verification prompt on your set-top box profile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for that backup option, Gary.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Keep the TV box tuned to channel 501 without changing channels to allow the broadcast stream to deliver the key packets.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just ensuring our premises records match perfectly: that was 18 Westmorland Road, wasn't it?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 18 Westmorland Road, Newcastle.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Philip, all premises and hardware records are fully synchronized.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will leave the TV on channel 501 and prepare the AirPlay casting just in case.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also applied a five-pound goodwill credit to your bill for the inconvenience.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you, that is appreciated.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Enjoy the derby match with your friends, Philip.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Gary. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other aspect of your TV service I can assist with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
